info.title: DNS Lookup: Bulk DNS Records, MX, SPF and DMARC Checker
info.description:
Bulk DNS lookup: A, MX, NS, TXT, SPF, DMARC and email provider in one row.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/dns-lookup
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/dns-lookup
Author: Public Records.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Start a run and read dataset items

post.description: Starts the Actor asynchronously. Poll the returned run, then read dataset items. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/dns-lookup

application/json.schema:
{
  "title": "DNS Lookup input",
  "type": "object",
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "properties": {
    "domains": {
      "title": "Domains",
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Domain names, one per line (for example `apify.com`). Website URLs and email addresses also work: the Actor takes the host name or the part after @. Duplicates are skipped.",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "prefill": [
        "apify.com",
        "github.com",
        "wikipedia.org"
      ],
      "default": [
        "apify.com",
        "github.com",
        "wikipedia.org"
      ]
    },
    "recordTypes": {
      "title": "Record types",
      "type": "array",
      "description": "DNS record types to return. Leave all selected for a full DNS report.",
      "editor": "select",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "A",
          "AAAA",
          "CNAME",
          "MX",
          "NS",
          "TXT",
          "SOA",
          "CAA"
        ],
        "enumTitles": [
          "A (IPv4)",
          "AAAA (IPv6)",
          "CNAME (alias)",
          "MX (mail servers)",
          "NS (name servers)",
          "TXT",
          "SOA",
          "CAA (certificate authorities)"
        ]
      },
      "default": [
        "A",
        "AAAA",
        "CNAME",
        "MX",
        "NS",
        "TXT",
        "SOA",
        "CAA"
      ]
    },
    "emailChecks": {
      "title": "Check SPF, DMARC and email provider",
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Parse the SPF record, read the DMARC record at _dmarc.<domain>, and name the email provider from the MX hosts (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and others). Same price.",
      "default": true
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "domains"
  ]
}
